name: Gray Gardener Assassin OLD
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Sometimes referred to as an alley bow by rogues or ruffians, this small crossbow fires small bolts that are sometimes used to deliver poison to the target. It's small enough to be shot one-handed, but it still requires two hands to load.

items.name: Kukri
items.description: The blade of this foot-long knife curves inward and lacks a cross guard at the hilt.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

defensiveAbilities.name: Anonymity
defensiveAbilities.description: The Gray Gardener assassin has a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks and saving throws to conceal their identity and a +2 circumstance bonus to their Deception DC against effects that ferret out information about the Gray Gardener's identity.

defensiveAbilities.name: Gardener's Resolve
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The Gray Gardener assassin rolls a failure (but not a critical failure) on a Will save against an effect with the mental or fear trait

Requirements The Gray Gardener assassin's features are obscured by a mask or hood

Effect The Gray Gardener assassin takes 3d8 Mental Damage damage, and the saving throw is a success.

offensiveAbilities.name: Instant Opening
offensiveAbilities.description: The Gray Gardener assassin distracts a creature within 30 feet, using a few choice words or gestures. The creature is Off-Guard against the assassin's attacks until the end of the assassin's next turn. Depending on the distraction, this action gains either the auditory or the visual trait.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mark for Death
offensiveAbilities.description: The Gray Gardener assassin designates a single creature they can see and hear as their mark. This effect lasts until the mark dies or the assassin uses Mark for Death again. The assassin gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek the mark and on Deception checks to Feint against the mark. The assassin's melee and ranged Strikes gain the deadly d8 weapon traits when attacking the mark.

offensiveAbilities.name: Poison Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The Gray Gardener assassin is wielding a piercing or slashing weapon and has a free hand

Effect The assassin applies a poison to the weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Draw
offensiveAbilities.description: The Gray Gardener assassin Interacts to draw a weapon and then Strikes with that weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The Gray Gardener assassin deals an additional 6d6 precision damage precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Surprise Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are Off-Guard to the Gray Gardener assassin.
